title: Page 4
content_zh:
范蕙怡默默站在角落，这种场合她只是个小小的工作人员，可是看着他侃侃而谈的自信模样，也不禁稍微失神了。
除了一般人注意到的外貌之外，他的从容、条理清晰、自信满满，还有对公司经营方向的热忱，在在令她胸口灼热了起来，这是前所未有的事。在她眼中工作能力强的男人特别有魅力，而徐士凯无疑是其中翘楚。
台下几个女记者还有大会议室里的女职员都热烈的看着他，频频发散出电波希望引起这个男人的注意。如果可能，即使一秒钟也好，可以得到他的注目，就连死了也甘心——这是这里大部分女人的想法。
而范蕙怡发现自己竟然也掠过那样的念头。
太夸张了。她立刻摇摇头，甩开这根本就不像她会有的想法。
那如阳光般耀眼的男子不可能会注意到像她这样不起眼的女人，他们的人生一个在天上，一个在地下，永不可能有交集。
直到后来她吃够了苦楚才体会到——什么事情都不要说得太满……
加班到深夜对范蕙怡来说已经是家常便饭。
她的上司，集团创办人的三女儿，是个亲切优雅的中年妇女，但却不是个太热中工作的人，有了范蕙怡这个能干的助理以后，就迫不及待把手上的工作都丢给她，自己则乐得偷闲。
一整天打电脑下来眼睛跟身体都酸疼不堪，电梯一来，她根本累到没空注意电梯里有没有人就走进去了。
“你好，到一楼吗？”带着磁性的男性嗓音响起的时候她还愣了一下，抬头看到一张带着笑意的英俊脸孔，心霎时漏跳了一拍。
竟然是他！公司未来的继承人也需要加班到这么晚吗？
她点了点头。“谢谢。”
电梯感觉好窄，虽然只有他跟她……对了，还有他身边的女子，她认出那是他的秘书Sarah。
跟工作了一整天狼狈的她不同的是Sarah脸上的妆还像刚化好那样完美无瑕。她更佩服的是她竟然穿着那么高的细跟高跟鞋，而且显得很优雅自在的样子，那简直是一种特异功能。
“工作到这么晚啊？辛苦了。”
她很意外他竟然会跟她这种小人物攀谈，虽然可能只是礼貌性的问候，可是验证了人们对他的传言，他对每个人都很温柔亲切。这样的男人，也难怪桃花传闻不断。
她模糊的思了一声，低头没去看他。她已经接收到他身边女子射来的眼刀，决定还是别跟他多说话的好。
突地，一阵震动，然后电梯开始急速往下坠。
耳边传来Sarah的尖叫声，她没叫，只是抓着电梯里的扶手，伸出手去按下面几个楼层的按钮。电梯疾停下来，又是一阵大幅度的震动。

电梯不知道停在哪个楼层，但至少没有再下坠，可是Sarah的尖叫声不但没有停止，反而更加歇斯底里。
“怎、怎么会这样？天啊！好可怕、好可怕，我们会死掉！呜呜……我不要死啊！”
“没事的，一定马上有人来救我们出去的。”徐士凯安抚花容失色的Sarah，一边不自觉的看向电梯里的另一名女子。她没有哭也没叫，只是拼命按紧急按钮，试图跟外界取得联络。
这女孩真特别……
他不由得看呆了。
“呜呜……我不能呼吸了？好可怕，我怕我会死掉……”
Sarah脸上的妆完全被泪水弄花了，跟平常矫揉造作的模样天差地别，徐士凯看得有些想笑，却又努力忍住。
“忍耐一下，马上就可以出去了。”
他听到范蕙怡已经跟警卫联络上了。
“好了。”范蕙怡转头对徐士凯报告。“他们马上来帮我们脱困，我们只要保持冷静就会没事的。”
徐士凯看着眼前镇定的小女人，眼神中不禁闪过一阵激赏。
她跟他认识的女人都不一样。
“你叫什么名字？在哪个部门工作？”他对她很有兴趣。
范蕙怡愣了一下，似乎没料到他会这么问。
“范蕙怡，徐雪龄董事的助理。”
他还想继续跟她聊，Sarah却插嘴了。
“我头好晕，好不舒服。”她顺势倒在他怀里，试图独占他所有的注意力。
范蕙怡皱眉。
“你最好让她躺下来。”她从背着的大包包里拿出白花油。“这擦在太阳穴跟人中比较舒服。”
Sarah瞪大眼睛，“我、我才不要擦那什么怪味道的东西呢！”

“你不是说不舒服，是该擦点药。”
徐士凯从范蕙怡的手中接过白花油，忍着笑劝她收下。
范蕙怡看到Sarah瞪她，只觉她的行为非常奇怪，不过她没跟她计较，只当她是情绪极度不安下的反应。
“我还有扇子跟湿纸巾，对了，需要喝水的话也有矿泉水。”她又从大包包里拿出东西来，分别递给徐士凯跟Sarah。
徐士凯惊讶得张大眼。“你那是什么包包？哆啦A梦的口袋吗？装的东西可真不少。”
他弯起眉眼，微笑让他的俊脸更加令人心跳加速。
范蕙怡脸一红。“身为董事的助理，我有必要准备各种东西以应付任何状况。”
徐士凯赞赏的点头，对Sarah说：“你看看人家，这个助理多细心体贴。”
Sarah被自己上司念了一句，气得脸红脖子粗，又不敢反驳，只能再度狠狠瞪了范蕙怡一眼。
“你来公司多久了？一直在姑姑的手下工作吗？”徐士凯跟范蕙怡攀谈。说不出什么原因，他想要多了解这个女孩。
“三年了，不过以前念大学的时候有来过公司打过工。”
“三年？我怎么不记得有见过你？”
那是当然的，他怎么会记得她这么平凡的人。她想，不过没有说出口，只是耸耸肩。
“有没有兴趣转到我部门来？我可以给你更好的条件。”
她讶异的看他一眼，没有想到他会邀请她。
“不，我没有换工作的打算。”
“是吗？太可惜了，我很想延揽你这个好人才。”
“谢谢，不过您太过奖了。”
范蕙怡脸上不但没有被赞美得喜悦，反而像认定他只是在说客套话一样冷淡的回应，这使得徐士凯对她更有兴趣了。别说他的地位，就以他的长相，女人们面对他的时候总是想尽办法讨好，这不是他过度自我膨胀，而是事实。
从没有一个女孩像她这样。

第2章(2)
此时电梯外面传来警卫的声音，然后电梯门
他们的位置在两个楼层中间，要出去的话得爬上约一尺的落差。徐士凯先将Sarah抱上去，让外面的警卫接过她，当他要帮助电梯里另一名女子的时候，范蕙怡却僵硬得对他说不用，然后便自己往上爬。
她似乎不想跟他有任何接触呐！
徐士凯微微挑眉，看到她爬得有些辛苦的背影，还是忍不住上前帮了一把。
温热有力的手掌扶上她的腰际时她惊喘出声，男人的气味带着淡淡的薄荷香以及隐约的男性麝香。她从没跟一个男性靠得这么近，更遑论那名男性还是他这么有魅力的人。
“不、不用了，我自己可以……”她急急的扭动挣脱，一张脸涨得通红，死命低着头不看他，奋力往上爬。
她的腰肢不可思议的纤细，徐士凯有片刻的失神。虽是出于礼貌性的动作，可是在抬起她的时候，鼻间涌进了若有似无的清香，那香味深深的吸引着他，不像大部分围绕在他周围女性的那种呛人香水味，他发现自己竟喜欢上她的味道。
content_en:
Fan Huiyi stood silently in the corner. She was just a small staff member on this occasion, but looking at his confident appearance while talking, she couldn't help but feel a little lost.
In addition to the appearance that most people noticed, his calmness, clarity, confidence, and enthusiasm for the company's business direction made her chest feel hot. This was something she had never seen before. In her eyes, men with strong working ability are particularly attractive, and Xu Shikai is undoubtedly the leader among them.
Several female reporters in the audience and female staff in the large conference room looked at him enthusiastically, frequently sending out radio waves in the hope of attracting this man's attention. If possible, even for a second, I would be willing to die to get his attention - this is the thought of most women here.
And Fan Huiyi found that she had also had such thoughts.
Too exaggerated. She immediately shook her head, getting rid of the thought which was not like her at all.
It is impossible for a man who is as dazzling as the sun to notice an inconspicuous woman like her. Their lives are in the sky and the other is in the earth, and there will never be any intersection.
It wasn't until she suffered enough that she realized - don't talk too much about anything...
Working overtime until late at night has become a daily routine for Fan Huiyi.
Her boss, the third daughter of the founder of the group, is a kind and elegant middle-aged woman, but she is not a person who is too enthusiastic about work. After having Fan Huiyi as a capable assistant, she can't wait to leave all the work on her hands to her, and she is happy to take some time off.
After working on the computer all day, her eyes and body were sore. When the elevator came, she was too tired to pay attention to whether there was anyone in the elevator and walked in.
"Hello, are you coming to the first floor?" She was stunned for a moment when the magnetic male voice sounded. She looked up and saw a handsome face with a smile, and her heart skipped a beat.
It's him! Will the future heirs of the company also need to work so late?
She nodded. "Thank you."
The elevator felt so narrow, even though it was just him and her... By the way, there was also the woman beside him. She recognized it as his secretary Sarah.
Unlike her who had been in a panic after working all day, the makeup on Sarah's face was still as flawless as if it had just been put on. What she admired even more was that she actually wore such high stilettos and looked very elegant and comfortable. It was a special function.
"You work so late? Thank you for your hard work."
She was surprised that he would talk to a little person like her. Although it might just be a polite greeting, it confirmed people's rumors about him. He was gentle and kind to everyone. For such a man, it's no wonder that rumors of love affairs continue.
She thought vaguely and lowered her head without looking at him. She had already received the glare from the woman next to him and decided not to talk to him anymore.
Suddenly, there was a vibration, and then the elevator began to fall rapidly.
Sarah's screams came to her ears. She didn't scream, she just grabbed the handrail in the elevator and reached out to press the buttons for the lower floors. The elevator stopped quickly and there was another large vibration.
The elevator didn't know which floor it stopped at, but at least it didn't fall any further. However, Sarah's screams not only didn't stop, but became even more hysterical.
"How, how could this happen? Oh my god! It's so scary, so scary, we will die! Woohoo... I don't want to die!"
"It's okay, someone will come to rescue us soon." Xu Shikai comforted Sarah, who was pale in beauty, while unconsciously looking at the other woman in the elevator. She didn't cry or scream, she just pressed the emergency button desperately and tried to contact the outside world.
This girl is so special...
He couldn't help but stare.
"Woo... I can't breathe? It's so scary, I'm afraid I'll die..."
The makeup on Sarah's face was completely stained by tears, which was completely different from her usual artificial look.Xu Shikai wanted to laugh a little, but tried hard to hold it back.
"Be patient, you can go out soon."
He heard that Fan Huiyi had contacted the guard.
"Okay." Fan Huiyi turned to Xu Shikai and reported. "They're coming right away to help us out, and we just have to stay calm and we'll be fine."
Xu Shikai looked at the calm little woman in front of him, and a burst of appreciation flashed in his eyes.
She was different from any woman he knew.
"What's your name? Which department do you work in?" He was very interested in her.
Fan Huiyi was stunned for a moment, as if she didn't expect him to ask this.
"Fan Huiyi, assistant to Director Xu Xueling."
He wanted to continue chatting with her, but Sarah interrupted.
"I feel so dizzy and uncomfortable." She fell into his arms, trying to monopolize all his attention.
Fan Huiyi frowned.
"You'd better let her lie down." She took out the white flower oil from the big bag she was carrying. "This is more comfortable when rubbed on the temples and on the inside of the body."
Sarah's eyes widened, "I-I don't want to rub that weird-smelling thing!"
"It's not that you feel uncomfortable, but you should apply some medicine."
Xu Shikai took the white flower oil from Fan Huiyi's hand and persuaded her to accept it while holding back a smile.
When Fan Huiyi saw Sarah glaring at her, she thought her behavior was very strange, but she didn't care about it and just regarded it as a reaction due to extreme emotional upset.
"I also have a fan and wet wipes. By the way, I also have mineral water if you need to drink water." She took out something from the big bag and handed it to Xu Shikai and Sarah respectively.
Xu Shikai opened his eyes in surprise. "What kind of bag is that of yours? Is it Doraemon's pocket? It can hold a lot of things."
He arched his eyebrows and smiled, making his handsome face even more heart-pounding.
Fan Huiyi blushed. “As the director’s assistant, I have to prepare various things to deal with any situation.”
Xu Shikai nodded appreciatively and said to Sarah, "Look at me, this assistant is so attentive and considerate."
Sarah was so angry that her boss said something to her, and she blushed and felt thick-necked. She didn't dare to refute, so she could only give Fan Huiyi a hard look again.
"How long have you been in the company? Have you been working under your aunt?" Xu Shikai chatted with Fan Huiyi. For no apparent reason, he wanted to know more about this girl.
"It's been three years, but I used to work in a company when I was in college."
"Three years? Why don't I remember seeing you?"
Of course, how could he remember such an ordinary person like her. she thought, but didn't say it, just shrugged.
"Are you interested in transferring to my department? I can give you better conditions."
She looked at him in surprise, not expecting that he would invite her.
"No, I have no plans to change my job."
"Really? What a pity. I really want to recruit a good talent like you."
"Thank you, but that's too much of a compliment."
Not only did Fan Huiyi's face show no joy at being praised, but she responded coldly as if she thought he was just saying polite words, which made Xu Shikai even more interested in her. Not to mention his status, just based on his appearance, women always try their best to please him when they face him. This is not his excessive self-aggrandizement, but a fact.
There has never been a girl like her.
Chapter 2(2)
At this time, the guard's voice came from outside the elevator, and then the elevator door
Their location is in the middle of the two floors. To get out, they have to climb up a drop of about one foot. Xu Shikai first carried Sarah up and asked the guards outside to take her over. When he wanted to help another woman in the elevator, Fan Huiyi was so stiff that she said no to him, and then climbed up by herself.
It seems like she doesn't want to have any contact with him!
Xu Shikai raised his eyebrows slightly, and when he saw her back struggling to climb, he couldn't help but step forward to help.
She gasped when warm and strong hands touched her waist, and the man's scent was faint.Mint and a hint of masculine musk. She had never been so close to a man, let alone one as charming as him.
"No, no need, I can do it myself..." She squirmed to break free, her face flushed red, her head lowered without looking at him, and she struggled to climb up.
Her waist was incredibly slender, and Xu Shikai was distracted for a moment. Although it was out of politeness, when he lifted her up, a vague fragrance rushed into his nose. The fragrance deeply attracted him. Unlike the choking perfume smell of most women around him, he found that he actually liked her smell.
